name: Rapel Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

notes: The Andes and Coastal Range trap warm, dry air here, while cool Andes nights keep acidity high alongside ripe fruit.

blurb.text: A subregion of the Central Valley, in the O'Higgins area that holds the Cachapoal and Colchagua Valleys. Cabernet Sauvignon is the most planted grape at 38 percent, followed by Carmenère, Merlot, Alicante Bouschet and Syrah.
